title: Autumn Salad with Apple Vinaigrette
description: A refreshing mix of crisp greens, juicy apples, and sweet vinaigrette, perfect for a light lunch or dinner.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens and shredded salad.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together the apple cider vinegar, olive oil, and honey until smooth.
3. Pour the vinaigrette over the salad and toss to combine.
4. Top the salad with diced apples and serve immediately.
5. For the vinaigrette, combine 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar, 1 tablespoon olive oil, and 1 teaspoon honey in a small bowl. Whisk until smooth.
